items.label: Sony Classical
items.note: Twelve piano pieces and an epilogue refer to Hensel’s Italian travels, with a Christmas chorale in ‘December’. Skride plays the whole calendar in the revised cycle, released in 2007, with clean fingerwork in its most demanding passages and clear pedalling in ‘September’, where the moving notes stay distinct around the melody.

items.work: Piano Trio in D minor, Op. 11
items.performers: Kaleidoscope Chamber Collective: Elena Urioste, violin; Laura van der Heijden, cello; Tom Poster, piano
items.label: Chandos
items.note: Written for her sister Rebecka’s birthday, the trio opens with violin and cello in octaves over a surging piano part. Urioste and van der Heijden play the two short middle movements as a singing partnership.
